# Notebooks on your own hardware

This notebook is being evaluated by the kernel shown in the header — by default a **real JVM running inside this browser tab** (OpenJDK on WebAssembly via CheerpJ). Nothing you run here leaves your machine.

Cells share one world, like any notebook: `def` something in one cell, use it in the next. The **last value** of each cell is rendered by *kind*, the way [Clay](https://scicloj.github.io/clay/) does with kindly annotations.
A seq of maps renders as a **table** automatically:
Vectors starting with a keyword render as **hiccup**:

[:div
 [:h3 "Rendered from data " [:em "inside the kernel"]]
 [:p {:style "color:#63b132"}
  "This HTML was generated by Clojure code, not JavaScript."]]
Maps with `:$schema` render with **vega-lite** (needs the CDN; otherwise you see the spec):
Force a rendering with the `kind` helpers — `(kind/table …)`, `(kind/hiccup …)`, `(kind/vega …)`, `(kind/md …)`, `(kind/value …)`:
